home.philosophyQuote: We choose each piece thinking about how it looks when worn.
home.philosophyP1: Clover was born from a taste for detail: earrings that light up a face, necklaces that keep you company, watches with presence.
home.philosophyP2: Every order is handled personally, the way things are done at home: we advise you, arrange payment and delivery with you.

selection.title: Careful selection
selection.text: We look at each piece as a whole: shape, weight, finish and how it moves on the skin.

detail.title: Attention to detail
detail.text: Clean lines and honest materials: pieces made for everyday life and for the moments that matter.

service.title: Personal service
service.text: We answer every question and follow your order on WhatsApp.

checkout.title: Complete your order
checkout.text: Leave your details and we will prepare your order to confirm it on WhatsApp. Nothing is charged on this page.
checkout.emptyText: Add a few pieces before placing your order.
checkout.deliveryNote: We only deliver within Venezuela. Delivery is arranged on WhatsApp (Turmero and Maracay); cost and timing are agreed according to your area.
checkout.payIntro: Choose how you would like to pay. Nothing is charged on this page: payment is arranged on WhatsApp when we confirm your order.

payChosen.pago-movil: You will pay with pago móvil (Venezuelan mobile payment). We send you the details on WhatsApp when we confirm your order.
payChosen.transferencia: You will pay by bank transfer. We send you the account details on WhatsApp when we confirm your order.
payChosen.efectivo: You will pay in cash. We agree on when and where on WhatsApp when we confirm your order.

errors.invalid: Please check your details and try again.
errors.cart_changed: Some items changed (stock or availability). We updated your summary: please review it.
errors.rate: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.

checkout.terms: Your order is saved and we confirm it on WhatsApp. By continuing you accept our terms.
checkout.successText: One last step: send us your order on WhatsApp so we can confirm availability, delivery cost and payment.
checkout.whatsappHint: If the button does not open WhatsApp, message us on <wa>WhatsApp</wa> and mention order {order}.

admin.productsText: Adjust price, stock per variant and visibility. Changes go live within a few minutes (or on the next publish).
admin.campaignsText: Change the video and copy of each homepage campaign block. Videos come from the media registry.
admin.title: Title
admin.mediaText: Videos available in the media registry. To use real footage, add files to /public/media/video and register them in src/content/media.ts.
admin.ordersHint: Confirm payment on WhatsApp and mark the order as “Paid”: that deducts inventory. If you cancel a paid order, inventory is restored.

journal.text: Notes on style, gifting and caring for your pieces.

lookbook.title: Lookbook
lookbook.text: A closer look at how the pieces are worn.

about.title: The house
about.text: A small store with a careful eye.
about.p1: Clover is a store in {area}, {locality}. We select accessories and pieces thinking about how they look when worn.
about.p2: We are not a cold shop. We handle every order personally, on WhatsApp, the way things are done at home: we advise you and arrange payment and delivery with you.
about.p3: The four-leaf clover in our mark is a wish: that each piece accompanies a good day.

one.title: Chosen, not accumulated
one.text: A smaller collection, looked at closely.

two.title: Honest descriptions
two.text: We say what each piece is and how it is finished — nothing more.

three.title: Close service
three.text: Real people answer, from the first question to delivery.
